appStore.priceNote: The price a fan pays in the iPhone app is whatever App Store Connect has set, shown by StoreKit in the fan's own currency - never read from this file. intendedPriceCents is the price 2026-09-rts-ios-v1/scripts/ios-price-table.json (generated 2026-09-23 at a 30% commission) asks asc-create-products.mjs to set; as of 2026-09-23 that script had not run against Apple, so what App Store Connect holds today is not recorded here.

googlePlay.note: No Google Play billing exists in the api or the web app today, so no Play product ids are listed. Add them here when Play billing is built.

notes: THE ONE PRICE FILE (Jeff 2026-09-29: 'ALL refs to prices should come from 1 json file somewhere on the site in assets'). Served at https://black-cat.club/assets/pricing.json.

Web reads it (src/app/checkout/pricing-catalog.ts imports it at build; PricingService re-reads the served copy). The api embeds this same file at build (Rts.Api.csproj EmbeddedResource, Services/PricingCatalog.cs). scripts/stripe-catalog.mjs sets Stripe's prices from it; scripts/check-prices.mjs compares it with Stripe TEST mode.

Prices are whole cents, in USD, before sales tax (taxExclusive: Stripe Tax adds tax at checkout, Jeff 2026-09-29). Tiers: HARD-RULES Rule 22. Single show: Rule 26 (Jeff wrote '$15'; 1495 is the committed value). Music-only: PRODUCT-MODEL section 1, monthly only. Token packs: Jeff 2026-09-23.
Token packs listed here are the priced packs; RTS_TOKEN_PACKS on the api still decides which of them are on sale.
Changing a price here does NOT change what Stripe charges: run scripts/stripe-catalog.mjs --apply-price-changes, and the api refuses a checkout whose Stripe price differs from this file.
